commit.message:
fix(JVT_BASE_MASK): allow fully-writable jvt.BASE on RV32

The RV32 constraint uses strict less-than which rejects 0xFFFFFFC0,
the correct mask for a fully-writable 26-bit BASE field (bits[31:6]).
Change to <= so implementations can declare all BASE bits writable.
fix(JVT_BASE_MASK): allow writable jvt.BASE and bump version to 0.1.9
